arguments.command:
cd /app/submission && python3 - <<'EOF'
import json
src=open('main.py').read().replace("\nmain()\n","")
lines=src.split("\n")
start=next(i for i,l in enumerate(lines) if l.startswith("def parse_states("))
end=next(i for i,l in enumerate(lines) if l.startswith("def parse_graph("))
body=lines[start:end]
dbg=[]
for l in body:
    dbg.append(l)
    s=l.strip()
    if s.startswith("raise Err"):
        dbg.append(' '*len(l[: l.index("raise")]) + 'print("RAISED at prev")')
mod="\n".join(lines[:start]) + "\n" + "\n".join(dbg) + "\n" + "\n".join(lines[end:])
g={}
exec(compile(mod,"m","exec"),g)
req=json.load(open('/app/tmp/t/one.json'))
try:
    g['parse_states'](req['states'],1,1,1)
except Exception as e:
    print("ERR", e.cat)
EOF
